title: ProviderDescriptor v1 (RATIFIED 2026-07-05)
$comment: STATUS: v1 — RATIFIED 2026-07-05 (operator, Option A per docs/campaigns/public-mvp/ratification-memo-work-container-v1.md). First provider: claude_code, STRUCTURALLY conformant (registered, fail-closed) with live supervised evidence via CD-4B (sess_aabb2a056f9f); RUNTIME (container-consumption) conformance not yet demonstrated — gated on S4 dispatch wiring. Schema changes from here are versioned (v1 → v2), not silent. This schema exports names for existing AG law; it does not create a new authority surface. A descriptor DECLARES capabilities; it does not confer trust or conformance. authority_claims is empty by construction (an external provider never declares authority). See docs/api/provider-integration.md. NOTE: no provider is declared conforming by the existence of this schema.

provider_kind.$comment: capability-shaped, not harness-shaped, so a transform provider (Polytoken) is not forced into an execution lane.

transports.description: How AG reaches this provider. Transport, not authority.

capabilities.description: CapabilityClass values this provider can perform.

custody_claims.$comment: What the provider claims it CAN produce as testimony. Claims, verified downstream; not authority.

authority_claims.$comment: does not mint: authority. Empty by construction in v1 (maxItems 0): a provider descriptor NEVER declares authority. AG internal components are not described by this external schema. A non-empty value is a conformance failure, not a grant.
